verdict.rationale: Docs confirm installation via GitHub/GitLab apps that connect repos to Bugbot, automatic reviews on every PR update, and findings posted as native inline PR comments with explanations/fix suggestions; community reports corroborate it running live in orgs' PR workflows. Minor gap: no explicit evidence of the 'within minutes' setup speed or independent onboarding walkthrough, missing for 10: independent verification of install speed/time-to-first-review, edge-case reliability data beyond mixed community sentiment.
